title: Predict, then reveal the explanation
description: Make a prediction in the first accordion panel, then open the counterexample and transfer question. This progressive-disclosure interaction differs from the original tab comparison.

blocks.title: Prediction
blocks.text: Two equal-size samples have the same mean. Must their values be distributed alike? Make a prediction before revealing the explanation.
Sample A: 4, 4, 4. Sample B: 0, 4, 8. Both means are 4, but the second sample has a wider spread.

blocks.title: What the mean omits
blocks.text: A center statistic does not describe the spread or shape of a distribution.
Transfer question: if two classes have the same average score, which additional information would help you compare their learning needs?
